title: Life Debt Backlog Burn-Down
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=quest:task debt_type=life_admin
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(status="done",1,0))) as cleared, count as total by _time
| eval backlog_remaining=total-cleared
| sort - _time
description: Tracks the weekly burn-down of nagging life-admin debt such as forms, calls, renewals, and errands.
value: A visible burn-down turns vague overwhelm into a queue you can actually shrink.
implementation: Tag life-admin debt in `quest:task` and chart weekly total versus cleared items.
visualization: Line chart of weekly life-debt backlog remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It maps whether the annoying little life-admin pile is shrinking or quietly growing.
